mapper.select: SELECT quote_id, user_id, basket_version, address_snapshot::text AS address_snapshot, subtotal_minor, discount_minor, shipping_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, currency, promised_from, promised_to, expires_at FROM quotes WHERE quote_id = #{quoteId}
